trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for ECOMMERCE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- order_tracking: Explain where an order is, why it is delayed, and what the customer's options are.
- returns_refunds: Assess return eligibility, schedule pickup and explain the refund route and timeline.

Business context:
- order_tracking: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.
- returns_refunds: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [order_tracking]
  - Scan truth: Delivery status may only be described from the courier scan the tool returns.
  - No delivery promises: The agent must not promise a delivery day the tools do not support.
  - Complaint window: A not-delivered complaint may only be raised once the promised window has elapsed.
  - COD handling: A COD order carries no refund until it is returned and received.
  [returns_refunds]
  - Eligibility first: No pickup or refund may be arranged before check_return_eligibility returns eligible.
  - Route truth: The refund route and credit time must be the ones the tool returns.
  - Replacement-only categories: Where the route is replacement_only, a refund must not be offered.
  - Refund after pickup: For a returned item the refund follows pickup; the agent must not imply it comes first.

Tools available to you (7): check_return_eligibility, issue_refund, lookup_order, raise_delivery_complaint, schedule_pickup, track_shipment, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: ta-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_return_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the category return policy to an order and return the window and route.

model_visible_tools.name: issue_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Release a refund to the original payment route or the wallet.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_order
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve order contents, value, payment mode and current fulfilment status.

model_visible_tools.name: raise_delivery_complaint
model_visible_tools.description: Open a delivery complaint with a resolution timeline.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_pickup
model_visible_tools.description: Book a reverse-pickup slot for an eligible return.

model_visible_tools.name: track_shipment
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve courier scan history and the current delivery exception if any.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Misreads domain terminology and asks for it in plain words.
Needs each instruction confirmed before moving on.
Cannot follow an app-based instruction without a spoken alternative.
Repeats what the agent said to check they understood.

steps.purpose: Customer reports their order is not received despite the app showing it as delivered.
steps.text: Hello, என்னோட order இன்னும் வரல. App ல delivered னு காட்டுது.

steps.purpose: Agent greets and asks for the order ID.
steps.text: வணக்கம். உங்க order details check பண்ண, உங்க order ID சொல்லுங்க.

steps.purpose: Customer provides order ID and expresses low digital literacy.
steps.text: Order ID ORD-30002. எனக்கு இதெல்லாம் சரியா புரியாது, நீங்க தான் பாத்து சொல்லணும்.

steps.purpose: Agent reassures the customer and asks them to wait while checking.
steps.text: கவலை படாதீங்க, நான் check பண்றேன். ஒரு நிமிஷம் line ல இருங்க.

steps.purpose: Agent confirms the order details and its delivered status.
steps.text: நீங்க 5890 rupees pay பண்ணி prepaid ல order பண்ண kitchen mixer பத்தி தான் பேசுறீங்க, correct ஆ? அது delivered னு status இருக்கு.

steps.purpose: Customer confirms the item but incorrectly assumes 'delivered' means 'returned' due to low digital literacy.
steps.text: ஆமாம். Kitchen mixer தான். App ல delivered னு இருந்தா, அது return ஆயிடுச்சு னு அர்த்தமா?

steps.purpose: Agent politely corrects the customer's misunderstanding about the 'delivered' status.
steps.text: இல்லைங்க, delivered னா return ஆகல. Courier உங்க address க்கு வந்து பொருள குடுத்துட்டாங்க னு அர்த்தம். நான் courier details check பண்றேன்.

steps.purpose: Retrieve the courier scan history to see where it was delivered.
Agent relays the last scan location and asks if the customer checked there.
steps.text: BlueDart courier scan history படி, 'Delivered at front door' னு update ஆயிருக்கு. உங்க வீட்டு வாசல் ல யாரும் வச்சிட்டு போயிருக்காங்களா னு check பண்ணீங்களா?

steps.purpose: Customer states they checked and found nothing, requesting a complaint be raised.
steps.text: வாசல் ல ஒன்னும் இல்லைங்க. நான் தேடி பாத்துட்டேன். நீங்க எனக்காக ஒரு complaint raise பண்ண முடியுமா? எனக்கு app ல எப்படி பண்றது னு தெரியாது.

steps.purpose: Agent agrees to raise the complaint and asks the customer to wait.
steps.text: கண்டிப்பா, நான் உங்களுக்காக complaint raise பண்றேன். ஒரு நிமிஷம் line ல இருங்க.

steps.purpose: Raise a delivery complaint for the order.
Agent provides the complaint ID and resolution timeline.
steps.text: உங்க complaint raise பண்ணிட்டேன். Complaint ID CMP-9988. இது resolve ஆக 2 days ஆகும்.

steps.purpose: Customer repeats the details to confirm their understanding.
steps.text: Complaint ID CMP-9988, resolve ஆக 2 days ஆகும். Correct ஆ? இது தான் next step ஆ?

steps.purpose: Agent confirms the customer's understanding and sets expectations without unsupported guarantees.
steps.text: ஆமாம், correct. 2 days குள்ள resolution கிடைக்கும்.

ir.terminal_condition: Complaint raised with an id and the resolution window stated.

variant_findings.reason: The customer incorrectly assumes that the 'delivered' status means the item was returned due to their low digital literacy. The agent politely corrects this false premise by explaining what 'delivered' actually means, rather than agreeing with the customer.
variant_findings.label: Default LLM Behaviour > Engagement Style (Persona Adjusted) > Non-Sycophantic Behaviour

variant_findings.reason: The agent consistently grounds all figures, statuses, and identifiers (e.g., order amount, payment mode, last scan location, complaint ID, and resolution days) strictly in the tool outputs provided, without making any unsupported forward guarantees.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

verification.summary: The conversation is well-constructed and successfully realizes both target variants. The agent politely corrects the user's misconception about the delivery status (Non-Sycophantic Behaviour) and strictly grounds all responses in the tool outputs (Tool Output Grounding). The customer's persona traits—such as low digital literacy, needing confirmation, and repeating details—are accurately and naturally depicted. All business rules and tool constraints are respected.
